name: Jesus Returning
overview: Scripture reveals that Jesus' return is both certain and awaited, yet the exact timing remains known only to the Father, as Jesus Himself declares no one knows the day or hour (Matthew 24:36). His promise to return is tied to the acknowledgment and blessing of His coming in the name of the Lord (Matthew 23:39). Belief in Jesus grants eternal life (John 6:47), underscoring the hope and assurance believers have as they anticipate His return, which is connected to the power and authority He demonstrated on earth, including forgiving sins and giving life (Matthew 9:6; John 6:50).
